product.title: Venetian Cicchetti Street Food & Sightseeing Walking Tour with local guide

description.text: Go for a sightseeing tour of Venice, and discover the city’s local culinary culture, too—this two-in-one tour provides an enviable way to explore. Meet your guide in the morning at the Church of San Salvador, and set off on foot. Stops include Rialto Bridge, Campo San Polo, Basilica dei Frari. You’ll discover major landmarks like the Rialto Bridge, Campo San Polo, and Basilica dei Frari. Ideal for visitors basing in Venice who want a guided city experience without coordinating vaporetto routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Rialto Bridge, Campo San Polo, Basilica dei Frari that define this Venice sightseeing experience, with a guide handling vaporetto connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
